answer_1.quote: The task of style transfer on text data involves changing the style of a given sentence while preserving its semantics.

answer_2.quote: We build our style classifier by fine-tuning RoBERTa-large on all our datasets, leading to significantly more reliable ACC evaluation.

answer_4.quote: Given the original sentence and the transferred sentence, annotators on Amazon Mechanical Turk can choose one of three options: 0 for no paraphrase relationship; 1 for an ungrammatical paraphrase; and 2 for a grammatical paraphrase.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators choose from three options based on paraphrase relationship and grammaticality.
